opening_seg — MV morphology op

• Data kinds: mask × mask → labels2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.opening_seg(region, se) (to call the implementation directly, import mvmorph; mvmorph.opening_seg(region, se); from the registry, opsmv.get("opening_seg"))

• HALCON equivalent: opening_seg (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Separate objects joined by necks with an erosion and grow them back inside the region as labels.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

構造要素で収縮 → 連結成分 → 各成分を最寄りの画素へ広げる(region の中だけ)。収縮で全部消えると全 0 のラベルを返す(理由: 切り離す種が残らない)。空の入力(region が 0 要素)は ValueError。

Args:

region: 2-D の領域。

se: 構造要素(奇数辺の bool 配列)。

Returns:

region と同じ形の整数ラベル画像(背景 0、物体 1..n)。
